app.name: PeopleForge
app.tagline: Increment requests and group-level employee data in one place.

home.heading: Welcome
home.intro: Submit and track increment requests, and give Sirius HR a single source of truth for employee data across all entities.
home.incrementPortalBody: Create requests, evidence the eligibility criteria and follow each request to a decision.
home.groupDashboardBody: Upload entity data, review anomalies and produce monthly, quarterly and annual reports.
